name: HEARTS
description: Hearts is a classic trick-taking card game belonging to the 'evasion' family. Unlike most trick-taking games, the goal is to avoid winning tricks that contain penalty cards. Each heart is 1 penalty point, and the Queen of Spades is 13. The ultimate objective is to have the lowest score, or to 'Shoot the Moon' by taking all penalty cards.

content.text: Hearts is a classic trick-taking card game belonging to the 'evasion' family. Unlike most trick-taking games, the goal is to avoid winning tricks that contain penalty cards. Each heart is 1 penalty point, and the Queen of Spades is 13. The ultimate objective is to have the lowest score, or to 'Shoot the Moon' by taking all penalty cards.
Hearts appeared in the USA in the 1880s, based on earlier evasion games from Europe such as Reversis and Polignac.
4 players playing individually. For 3 players remove the 2 of Diamonds. For 5 players remove two low cards.
Standard 52-card deck. Ranking: Ace (high) down to 2 (low) in each suit.

Deal all 13 cards to each player (one at a time, face-down). After looking at their hands, players pass 3 cards to an opponent. Passing direction rotates each round: Left, Right, Across, then No Pass (a 'hold' round). This 4-round cycle repeats.

items.text: Omnibus Hearts: The Jack of Diamonds is worth -10 points (bonus). Adds an incentive to take certain tricks.
Spot Hearts: Each heart card is worth its face value in penalty points (Ace=14, King=13, etc.) instead of 1 point each.
Cancellation Hearts: For 6-8 players using two decks. When two identical cards appear in the same trick, they cancel each other out. Cancelled cards cannot win the trick.
